About FRS The Financial Resources and Strategy (FRS) team optimizes the Firms financial resources and develops strategic initiatives to support growth and resilience, working directly with the heads of the Firms Institutional Securities businesses and partnering with Corporate Treasury, Finance and Risk. The team is also responsible for pricing resource-intensive transactions in particular uncollateralized corporate derivatives and structured financing. The Mumbai team supports the global group headquartered in New York. FRS is organized into four sub-teams: Capital Manages the Firms capital structure and regulatory capital compliance. Funding Optimizes the sources and costs of financing across markets. Liquidity Maintains liquidity buffers and strategies to meet obligations under stress. Margin Optimizes margin and resource allocation across trading and client activity. About the Role A hybrid role at the intersection of quantitative strats work and front-office commercial decision-making. You will price capital- and funding-intensive transactions alongside sales, structuring and GCM, and build the models, analytics and tooling that make that pricing scalable and repeatable. You will develop deep expertise in how capital, funding and liquidity regimes translate into the economics of a trade a scarce skill set with broad onward paths across FRS, Strats and the trading businesses. What You Will Do / Responsibilities Pricing, structuring and business engagement Price capital- and funding-intensive transactions, with a focus on corporate derivatives and structured financing. Work with sales, structuring and GCM to structure trades optimally thinking through client requests, carry profiles and cash flows to make the pricing work. Advise business heads on the impact of regulatory and internal resource hurdles, and on optimizing the product footprint to maximize returns. Support SFT / GSIB / NSFR optimization; track overborrow, funding inefficiencies and margin concentration, and partner with desks, ops and strats to drive fixes to closure. Modelling, analytics and tooling Build tools that automate valuation and risk metrics for repos, stock loans and total return swaps, and for the swaps and options used in pricing capital hurdles. Own pricing, reporting and analytical frameworks end to end, including dashboards that track and forecast capital, margin, funding and liquidity metrics for traders and business operators. Build a working knowledge of capital, funding and liquidity rules and models, and translate them into analysis the business can act on. Partner with technology to deliver robust, scalable, production-ready solutions, and keep communication with GCM, Controllers, Corporate Treasury, Finance, Risk and regional counterparts tight and decision-oriented. Skills Required Experience: 25 years at an investment bank or similar institution, in a role requiring both programming skills and an understanding of financial products. Technical: Python (Pandas, NumPy) and strong Excel; clean, maintainable code and reproducible workflows rather than one-off scripts. Quantitative: Solid financial mathematics discounting, curves, derivative valuation and risk sensitivities. Products: Derivatives, plus working knowledge of repo / stock loan / SFT, CCP margin, and collateral and liquidity drivers. Capital regimes: Familiarity with RWA, CCAR, GSIB, NSFR and LCR, and with balance sheet and funding models. Communication: Ability to summarize complex problems and detailed analysis with clarity and brevity, in writing and in person, for busy stakeholders. Mindset: Ownership and a bias for action; frames ambiguous problems, proposes options with trade-offs, and follows through. Integrity in handling confidential information. Nice to Have q / KDB+, Git, Scala or Java, Power BI or Tableau, or exposure to Data Fabric and other firm data platforms. 324fe38f565ec373.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

Our Product Managers imagine the ideal experience for our community and work backwards, creating innovative products that delight our guests and hosts. They deeply understand the needs of our users and translate these into a strategy that combines strong product thinking and deep research. They partner with talented cross-functional team members across engineering, design, operations, data science, and more, leading teams to execute a shared vision. They are incredibly detail-oriented and hands on.

The Difference You Will Make:

You will be part of the team responsible for product roadmaps and launches at Airbnb. You will  drive specific features that are part of every launch and determine how they are communicated to the external world. You are responsible for the success of Airbnb products throughout their life cycle — from concept to release. And their cross-functional work ensures a consistent product voice across all the products being developed at Airbnb.

We are seeking a Product Manager to join our Community Support team. You will represent the voice of the user and collaborate with cross-functional design and engineering teams to build the experience for a magical differentiated service. 

A Typical Day: 

  • Develop and maintain a product vision, strategy, and roadmap for differentiated service. 
  • Synthesize feedback and translate it into product features.  
  • Develop a public facing messaging and narrative.
  • Align product teams and cross functional partners. 
  • Make judgements and prioritization decisions that are in the best interests of our users.
  • Efficiently execute to ship products and deliver impact for our business and users.

Your Expertise:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and progressive experience
  • 8+ years of product management experience.
  • Experience creating product messaging and delivering to customers and the media.
  • Demonstrated inbound and subject matter expertise
  • Be able to build compelling customer-focused stories and work with marketing and communications partners to bring them to life. 
  • Excited to work on a foundational service that supports a wide range of Airbnb features with the goal of bringing the best possible experience to all the guests and hosts on our platform.
  • Demonstrated track record of product leadership in a cross functional environment. 
  • Built and scaled global consumer products and ecosystems that people love.
  • Entrepreneurial track record of taking an idea to reality and leading teams through a dynamic environment.
  • Experience working on consumer products with a financial component.
  • A strong ability to effectively use data and perform business analysis to support product strategy/decisions.
  • Excited to drive execution across teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Enjoy doing individual contributor product management work and staying in the details. 

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager.
